scope: Development protocol informed by earlier experiments. Version 2 adds black-shadow-only controls after version 1 lost 66 white-stone photo probes. Version 3 distinguishes current-run support time from first-ever support after a candidate disappears or is occluded. Numeric thresholds are unchanged. This is not independent validation. No tuning loop or production integration. Shares are relative heuristic support, not probabilities. Missing appearance coverage is neutral, never zero or proof of emptiness.
